frames.gloss: 究竟为什么……？（分裂式强调问句，that 后用陈述语序）
frames.pattern_notes: it 为分裂句形式主语，被强调成分是 why；that 从句内必须用陈述语序、不再倒装。学习者易按 why is it 的普通倒装惯性在 that 后继续倒装，或把 it 当作有实指的代词。两处均为阅读正文中的设问句，用于引出下文的解释性列举。

examples.s: Why is it that on paper the drive for organisation seems a sure shot for increasing productivity, but in reality fells well short of what is expected?
F Why is it that in sects have received relatively little atte ntion in bioprospecti ng?

frames.gloss: 不是 A，而是 B（先否定再纠正的对比块）
frames.pattern_notes: not 否定前项，but rather 引出纠正项，rather 可被逗号夹住（I02666）；与清单内 not so much[A] as[B]（程度比较）和 That[X], rather than[Y], was[Z]（插入式取舍）不同，此处是 not...but rather 的直接否定-替换配对。学习者易把 rather 当独立评注副词，丢失与句首 not 的呼应，从而读反作者立场。

examples.s: These views are not based strictly, but rather, loosely, on the philosophies of Alexander Hamilton, Thomas Jefferson, and Andrew Jackson, three great statesmen in the history of the United States.

In the Jeffersonian view, the goal of education is not to favor or foster an elite, as in the Hamiltonian tradition, but rather to allow children the opportunities to make full use of the skills they have・ My own views are similar to these (Sternberg, 1997).

frames.gloss: X 被（专门）用于 / 让渡给 Y
frames.pattern_notes: give over to 的被动预制块，主语多为空间、成本、资源类名词，to 为介词，后接名词或动名词（was given over to ensuring...）。清单内 be home to、be known/regarded as 属同粒度的动词性预制块，本条不在清单。学习者不熟 give over 表"拨给专用"，易拆成 give + over（移交/结束）误读。

examples.s: Communal wards appropriate for in today's hospitals, at a fraction of the energy cost/ Professor Short contends the mindset and skill-sets behind these designs have been completely lost, lamenting the disappearanee of expertly designed theatres, opera houses, and other buildings where up to half the volume of the building was give n over to ensuri ng every one got fresh air.
Today, huge amounts of a building's space and construction cost are given over to air conditioning.

frames.frame: [V] ... on the basis of [NP / wh-从句]
frames.pattern_notes: 复合介词块作依据状语，置于谓语之后；槽位可填名词短语，也可填 wh-名词从句（on the basis of what they actually achieve），此时介词 of 直接带疑问从句，是清单"动词+介词+wh-从句"之外更书卷气的变体。学习者易把 basis 按字面"基础"理解，遇到接从句时断句困难。

examples.s: Job interviewers will make hiring decisions on the basis of their implicit theories of intelligence.
People will decide who to be friends with on the basis of such theories.
People should only gain benefits on the basis of what they actually achieve.

frames.pattern_notes: 对比连接块，as opposed to 整体相当于介词，后接名词或动名词；可夹于句中插入位置（I02585 括号内）或置于句尾（I02645 as opposed only to valuing...）。学习者易把 as...opposed 按 as...as 比较结构拆开，或把 opposed 读成谓语动词，导致主干误判。

examples.s: But why should we even care what people think intelligence is, as opposed only to valuing whatever it actually is?
Many of them embrace it in terms of perception (embracing the idea of disorder, as opposed to fearing it) and in terms of process (putting mechanisms in place to reduce structure).

frames.gloss: 而且，更有甚者（篇章递进标记）
frames.pattern_notes: 句首固定递进连接语，What 不是疑问词，后面不接 is/was + 补语的系表结构，而是逗号后直接跟完整主句；时态可随篇章变为 What was more。与清单内假分裂 What[S] V is/was[B] 形态相近但结构不同，学习者极易误按疑问句或分裂句等待一个名词性补足成分，造成回读。

examples.s: The result is that businesses and people spend time and money organising themselves for the sake of organising, rather than actually looking at the end goal and usefulness of such an effort, E Whafs more, recent studies show that order actually has diminishing returns.
What was more, the old ants didn't experience any drop in the levels of either serotonin or dopamine—brain chemicals whose decline often coincides with aging.

frames.gloss: X 取决于 Y / X 随 Y 而变化
frames.pattern_notes: 学术语篇名词化块：a function of 表示"由……决定、随……而变"，function 不取"功能"义；两种挂载方式 be a function of（I02662）与 vary as a function of（I02756）。学习者按"功能"字面理解会整句误读；与清单 be of+抽象名词 同属名词化预制块但语义角色不同。

examples.s: As mentioned earlier, people have expectations for intellectual performances that differ for children of different ages・ How these expectations differ is in part a function of culture.
The adulfs role in play varies as a function of their educational goals and the child's developmental level (Hirsch-Pasek et al. 2009).

frames.gloss: ……，而这一情况 / 事实又……（整句回指）
frames.pattern_notes: 总结性同位回指：something 概括前面整个命题，which 定语从句陈述它引发的后果。是清单"前句, which[谓语]"的新变体——插入 something 作显性回指头词，指代更清楚但形态更绕。学习者易把 something 当成指某个具体事物的泛指代词，在上下文中找不到所指而卡住。两例均出自剑14同一篇药品研发文章的不同段落。

examples.s: C Laboratory-based drug discovery has achieved varying levels of success, something which has now prompted the development of new approaches focusing once again on natural products.

Consequently, they have a bewildering array of interactions with other organisms, something which has driven the evolution of an enormous range of very interesting compounds for defensive and offensive purposes・ Their remarkable diversity exceeds that of every other group of animals on the plznet combi ned.

candidates.s: Maybe ifs time we changed our outlook, 43 Reading Passage 2 has nine sections, A-!.
candidates.note: It's time [S V-ed] 虚拟过去式（=早该……）。语域判据存疑：原句与题目指令 OCR 粘连，但本体是自然语篇引语；批次内仅 1 现。

candidates.s: 'This is the first time anyone has looked at both behavioral and neural changes in these ants so thoroughly/ says Giraldo, who recently published the findings in the Proceedings of the Royal Society B.
candidates.note: This is the first time [S has V-ed]：the first time 后接现在完成体从句且零关系词。骨架清晰但批次内仅 1 现。

candidates.s: Yet eve n though in sects are far and away the most diverse animals in existence, their potential as sources of therapeutic compounds is yet to be realised.
candidates.note: 一句含两个候选：far and away the + 最高级（=绝对最……）与 be yet to be [V-ed]（=尚未被……）。均有骨架、均易误读，但各仅 1 现。

candidates.s: Scientist David Hone makes the case for zoos A In my view, it is perfectly possible for many species of animals living in zoos or wildlife parks to have a quality of life as high as, or higher than, in the wild.
candidates.note: as [adj] as, or [比较级] than, [X]：自我修正的双重比较插入结构，第二个比较缺省比较对象（=than in the wild）。仅 1 现。

candidates.s: Then Giraldo compared the brains of 20-day-old and 95-day-old ants, identifying any cells that were close to death・ She saw no major differences with age, nor was there any difference in the location of the dying cells, showing that age didn5t seem to affect specific brain functions.
candidates.note: nor + 助动词/be 倒装（=也不……）并列承接否定句。属经典骨架但批次内仅 1 现；误读判据拿不准（学习者多已在语法书见过）。

candidates.s: Left to themselves, the unintelligent would create, as they always have created, a kind of chaos.
candidates.note: Left to [oneself], [S would V]：条件式放任假设（=如果任由……）。句中 as they always have created 属清单已有的主谓间插入语。整框仅 1 现。

candidates.s: This rhetoric has also crept into the thinking of business leaders and entrepreneurs, much to the delight of self-proclaimed perfectionists with the need to get everything right・ The number of business schools and graduates has massively increased over the past 50 years, essentially teaching people how to organise well.
candidates.note: much to the [情感抽象N] of [NP]（=令……大为……的是）。骨架典型，批次内仅 1 现。

candidates.s: At this mid-point between play and work, the child's motivation, coupled with guidance from an adult, can create robust opportunities for playful learning.
candidates.note: [NP], coupled with [NP], [谓语]：coupled with 作准并列插入。主谓间插入语清单已有，此为具体高频变体；仅 1 现。

candidates.s: Tor now, the study raises more questions than it answers/ Giraldo says, "including how P. dentata stays in such good shape.5 Also, if the ants don't deteriorate with age? why do they die at all?
candidates.note: raise more questions than [it] answers（=引出的问题比解决的多）：学术评价惯用语。仅 1 现。

candidates.s: Securing sufficie nt numbers of the organism in question, isolating and characterising the compounds of interest, and producing large quantities of these compounds are all significant hurdles.
candidates.note: the [N] in question（=所论及的、正被讨论的 N）后置修饰。仅 1 现；误读判据拿不准（词块较常见）。另：本句三个 V-ing 并列主语属清单已有 V-ing主语。

candidates.s: But the possibility also needs to be taken into account that the explicit theories are wrong and in need of correction or supplementation.
candidates.note: take [NP] into account 被动化后，that 同位语从句与中心名词 possibility 被谓语隔开。骨架判据拿不准：更像重成分移位语法现象；仅 1 现。

candidates.s: In the eyes of a young child, running, pretending, and building are fim.
candidates.note: In the eyes of [NP], [主句]（=在……看来）视角标记。仅 1 现。

candidates.s: The founder of the National Institute for Play, Stuart Brown, has described play as 'anything that spontaneously is done for its own sake'.
candidates.note: for [its/their/one's] own sake（=为了其本身）批次内 2 现（另见 I02720 have a right to exist for their own sake），但误读判据拿不准：语义透明度高，近词块而非易误读框架。

candidates.s: I With every bit of wilderness that disappears, we deprive ourselves of potential medici nes.
candidates.note: With every [N] that [V], [主句]（=每……就随之……）伴随递增结构。仅 1 现。

candidates.s: The concept of intelligence A Looked at in one way, everyone knows what intelligence is; looked at in another way, no one of intelligence, but no one knows for certain what it actually is.
candidates.note: Looked at in one way, [S]; looked at in another way, [S]：成对被动分词视角对照（=从一个角度看……换个角度看……）。仅 1 现（OCR 有粘连）。

candidates.s: Order does increase productivity to a certain extent, but eventually the usefulness of the process of organisation, and the benefit it yields, reduce until the point where any further increase in order reduces productivity.
candidates.note: to/until the point where [S V]（=到……的地步/程度），where 从句修饰 point 易误读为地点。仅 1 现；本句 does increase 属清单已有强调 do。

candidates.s: As much as I'd love to help develop a groun dbreaki ng in sect-derived medicine, my main motivation for looking at insects in this way is conservation.
candidates.note: 清单 much as[S V] 的扩展变体 As much as I'd love to [V], [主句]（=尽管我很想……但）。仅 1 现，且是否应并入清单项拿不准。
